markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (46%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Three classes stay plausible [F1] and the reliability check flagged the image [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 46%, Benign 38%, Normal 13%, Invasive 3% | Top two close |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu | Three classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.48 / OOD 1.0, flagged | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees, but input suspect |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 InSitu; all Normal | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 6, 7) · context · Above typical; descriptive only · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored below typical; concept unreliable · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score; spot check only 12/20 · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits non-invasive tissue · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG degradation (severity 3) distorted features; OOD is 1.0, so all probabilities are suspect.
- All five neighbors are Normal; the true class may be Normal or Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7**: Check lymphocyte density; the necrosis score here has a poor 3/20 spot check.
2. **Region 1**: Look for atypical cells confined within ducts.
3. **Region 5**: Highest per-region invasive probability (55%); confirm no invasive focus.
